Action.title: Action
Action.description: A follow-up step shown next to a message (``LinkButton``).

AnalysisId.title: AnalysisId
AnalysisId.description: Analyses with an availability status (design v3 ``ANALYSES``).

missing_signals.title: Missing Signals
missing_signals.description: Signal ids that are not mapped or silent.

min_stop_cycles.title: Minimum aantal stops tijdens vraag
min_stop_cycles.description: Minimum aantal herhaalde stops voor een patroonmelding.

min_temperature_cycles.title: Minimum aantal temperatuurafwijkingen
min_temperature_cycles.description: Minimum aantal cycli met een waargenomen afwijking.

overshoot_margin_c.title: Marge voor doorschieten
overshoot_margin_c.description: Aanvoer boven gewenst plus deze marge; geen universele schadelijkheidsgrens.

short_cycle_min.title: Kortecyclusgrens
short_cycle_min.description: Een cv-cyclus die korter duurt dan deze grens én stopt terwijl de thermostaat nog warmte vraagt, telt als korte cyclus.

demand_after_stop_s.title: Warmtevraag na stop
demand_after_stop_s.description: Hoe lang de warmtevraag na het stoppen van de brander nog moet aanhouden om te spreken van "stop tijdens vraag".

min_short_cycles.title: Minimum aantal korte cycli
min_short_cycles.description: Zoveel korte cycli moeten er binnen één beoordeling zijn voordat de app een patroon meldt. Eén korte cyclus is nooit een waarschuwing.

few_active_zones_max.title: Grens voor weinig actieve zones
few_active_zones_max.description: Alleen ingevuld als je zelf een aantal zones kiest; anders worden alleen gemeten aantallen vergeleken zonder laag-/hooglabel of diagnose.

min_observation_hours.title: Minimale observatieduur
min_observation_hours.description: Zoveel uur met gegevens tijdens cv-bedrijf of warmtevraag is nodig voordat de app iets over cycli concludeert. Uren zonder gegevens tellen niet mee.

repetition_days.title: Herhaling over dagen
repetition_days.description: Een patroon heet structureel als het op minstens zoveel dagen binnen de periode voorkomt.

repetition_window_days.title: Herhaling: van de laatste
repetition_window_days.description: Lengte van de periode waarbinnen de herhaling wordt geteld.

comfort_margin_c.title: Comfortgrens
comfort_margin_c.description: Een ruimte telt als te koud als de gemeten temperatuur meer dan zoveel graden onder het setpoint ligt.

allowed_comfort_loss_h_per_week.title: Toegestaan comfortverlies
allowed_comfort_loss_h_per_week.description: Standaard terugdraaicriterium per ruimte: zoveel uur per week mag een ruimte te koud zijn na een wijziging.

comparison_days.title: Lengte vergelijkingsperiode
comparison_days.description: Even lange periode vóór en ná de wijziging. Gemarkeerde perioden worden eruit gelaten.

comparable_weather_c.title: Vergelijkbaar weer
comparable_weather_c.description: Verschil in gemiddelde buitentemperatuur waarbinnen de perioden vergelijkbaar zijn.

limited_weather_c.title: Beperkt vergelijkbaar weer
limited_weather_c.description: Tot dit verschil is de vergelijking beperkt (lagere zekerheid); daarboven rapporteert de app geen effect.

min_period_coverage_pct.title: Minimale dekking per periode
min_period_coverage_pct.description: Zoveel procent van de tijd moeten de benodigde signalen gegevens hebben in beide perioden.

min_assessment_coverage_pct.title: Minimale dekking voor een beoordeling
min_assessment_coverage_pct.description: Onder deze dekking van de kernsignalen toont het Overzicht "Onvoldoende gegevens" en geeft de app geen beoordeling.

flame_resolution_s.title: Gewenste meetresolutie vlamstatus
flame_resolution_s.description: Hoe vaak de vlamstatus minimaal ververst moet worden.

retention_days.title: Bewaartermijn ruwe gegevens
retention_days.description: Ruwe meetwaarden ouder dan dit worden opgeruimd. Afgeleide cycli, bevindingen en advieshistorie blijven bewaard.

recovery_days.title: Dagen zonder patroon
recovery_days.description: Zoveel aaneengesloten dagen moet het patroon weg zijn.

recovery_comparable_weather_only.title: Alleen bij vergelijkbaar weer
recovery_comparable_weather_only.description: Herstel telt alleen als het weer vergelijkbaar is met de periode waarin het patroon optrad.

recovery_min_coverage_pct.title: Minimale dekking in herstelperiode
recovery_min_coverage_pct.description: Zoveel procent gegevens is nodig in de herstelperiode.

postpone_days.title: Uitstellen standaard
postpone_days.description: Termijn achter de knop "Uitstellen" bij een advies.

gas_price_eur_per_m3.title: Gasprijs
gas_price_eur_per_m3.description: All-in prijs per m³. Leeg laten = geen euro's.

show_explanations.title: Uitleg tonen
show_explanations.description: Toont uitleg bij kengetallen, begrippen bij bevindingen en de uitlegbanners.

AnalysisSettings.title: AnalysisSettings
AnalysisSettings.description: All user-adjustable analysis settings with their defaults (proposals, §7 q4).

AssessmentLevel.title: AssessmentLevel
AssessmentLevel.description: Overall judgement level (§5c); ``insufficient_data`` forbids any green verdict.

text.title: Text
text.description: Dutch display text, e.g. 'Pas 2 van 6 uur met gegevens.'

AvailabilityStatus.title: AvailabilityStatus
AvailabilityStatus.description: Beschikbaar / beperkt / niet beschikbaar (FR-04). Ordered by strength.

source.title: Source
source.description: Rule and version, e.g. 'Stop tijdens vraag · v1.1'.

BundledEvidence.title: BundledEvidence
BundledEvidence.description: A supporting candidate bundled into this finding (FR-26).

Category.title: Category
Category.description: Finding category (design v3 ``cat``; the UI maps these to Dutch labels).

Certainty.title: Certainty
Certainty.description:
Zekerheid as an ordered, documented category (FR-22, FR-28; ADR-004 §5).

Order (weak → strong): ``INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE`` < ``PRELIMINARY`` < ``MODERATE`` <
``REASONABLE`` < ``HIGH`` < ``HIGH_MEASURED``.

result_expected_at.title: Result Expected At
result_expected_at.description: While pending: when the observation period is complete.

rooms.title: Rooms
rooms.description: Room keys served by this circuit.

end.title: End
end.description: null when the end is unknown (data gap).

duration_s.title: Duration S
duration_s.description: Known duration; a lower bound if incomplete.

observed_hours.title: Observed Hours
observed_hours.description: Hours with data in the range.

missing_signals.title: Missing Signals
missing_signals.description: Signal ids or descriptions not available.

Evidence.title: Evidence
Evidence.description: Onderbouwing (FR-22) - structured facts plus their display texts.

EvidenceDisplay.title: EvidenceDisplay
EvidenceDisplay.description: The four evidence tiles as shown in design v3.

start.title: Start
start.description: Range start, or the cycle/metric/event start.

EvidenceLink.title: EvidenceLink
EvidenceLink.description: Link from a finding to the data it is based on (FR-37): shown as 'Toon in tijdlijn'.

ExperimentCreate.title: ExperimentCreate
ExperimentCreate.description: Start following one existing single-parameter change.

ExperimentOut.title: ExperimentOut
ExperimentOut.description: Experiment lifecycle and the existing change evaluation it reuses.

FieldError.title: FieldError
FieldError.description: One validation error (``422``), shown on the matching form field.

timeline_range.description: Range for 'Toon in tijdlijn'; null when not cycle based.

evidence_links.title: Evidence Links
evidence_links.description: Time ranges, cycles and signals behind the finding.

open_count.title: Open Count
open_count.description: Findings with status open or rollback.

postponed_until.title: Postponed Until
postponed_until.description: Defaults to now + the 'Uitstellen standaard' setting.

FindingStatusUpdate.title: FindingStatusUpdate
FindingStatusUpdate.description: ``POST /api/findings/{id}/status``; ``rollback_triggered`` is set by the app only.

clock_offset_ms.title: Clock Offset Ms
clock_offset_ms.description: Median app receipt time minus HA event time; positive means HA is behind.

HaConnectionStatus.title: HaConnectionStatus
HaConnectionStatus.description: ``GET /api/ha/status``: whether HA is configured and the live connection is up.

HaEntity.title: HaEntity
HaEntity.description:
A Home Assistant entity for the entity picker (design additions §3b, #17).

Optional fields are ``null`` when Home Assistant does not provide them; area and device
come from the HA registries and are not part of the state list.

state.title: State
state.description: Raw state as Home Assistant receives it.

display.title: Display
display.description: Dutch formatted value for the UI.

since.title: Since
since.description: Time of the last state change.

rule_now_text.title: Rule Now Text
rule_now_text.description: What changed in the rule since the snapshot.

HistoryEntry.title: HistoryEntry
HistoryEntry.description: A recommendation snapshot as recorded at the time (FR-41).

earliest_available_at.title: Earliest Available At
earliest_available_at.description: Oldest data the HA recorder still has.

revision.title: Revision
revision.description: Optimistic concurrency: send the revision read.

zones.title: Zones
zones.description: Omit only for legacy writes to preserve the current zone inventory.

revision.title: Revision
revision.description: Optimistic concurrency: send the revision read.

LiveState.title: LiveState
LiveState.description: Header status pill (design additions §0.3); 'app unreachable' is client-side.

since.title: Since
since.description: Start of the current non-live state (e.g. HA offline).

note_text.title: Note Text
note_text.description: Sub line, e.g. 'gemeten · 4 s' or 'niet gekoppeld'.

explanation.title: Explanation
explanation.description: KPI explanation (shown when 'uitleg tonen' is on).

LiveValue.title: LiveValue
LiveValue.description: KPI tile with a current measurement; ``value`` is ``null`` when unknown (§5a rule 5).

NextAction.title: NextAction
NextAction.description: 'Aanbevolen actie' (or 'Eerste stap' while setup is incomplete).

bundle_related.title: Bundle Related
bundle_related.description: Bundel meldingen die bij hetzelfde patroon horen.

renotify_on_worsening.title: Renotify On Worsening
renotify_on_worsening.description: Opnieuw melden als het erger wordt.

recovery_text.title: Recovery Text
recovery_text.description: Recovery criterion summary (from the settings, read-only here).

bundle_related.title: Bundle Related
bundle_related.description: Bundel meldingen die bij hetzelfde patroon horen.

renotify_on_worsening.title: Renotify On Worsening
renotify_on_worsening.description: Opnieuw melden als het erger wordt.

window.description: Analysed window (also the mini timeline range).

total.title: Total
total.description: Number of items over all pages.

total.title: Total
total.description: Number of items over all pages.

PeriodExclusions.title: PeriodExclusions
PeriodExclusions.description: What the period does not count for (all on by default, design additions §3a).

PriorityOut.title: PriorityOut
PriorityOut.description: Why the finding ranks where it does: score = product of the factor weights.

RecommendationOut.title: RecommendationOut
RecommendationOut.description: Advice in the format of requirements §5 / FR-25; null fields are not shown.

RecommendationOutcome.title: RecommendationOutcome
RecommendationOutcome.description: FR-25: after execution a recommendation is succeeded, unfavourable or undecided.

has_more_cycles.title: Has More Cycles
has_more_cycles.description: True when more than 500 cycles fall in the period.

comfort.description: A recurring user comfort schedule; null on legacy writes means preserve it.

RoomComfort.title: RoomComfort
RoomComfort.description: Explicit user intent; unconfigured stays distinct from no expectation.

RoomComfortOverride.title: RoomComfortOverride
RoomComfortOverride.description: A room-specific expectation during an existing special period.

RoomComfortWindow.title: RoomComfortWindow
RoomComfortWindow.description: One recurring local-time comfort target for selected weekdays.

SampledSeries.title: SampledSeries
SampledSeries.description: Values on a regular grid ``start + i * step_s``; ``null`` = no data.

ScopeKind.title: ScopeKind
ScopeKind.description: What a parametrised signal role is scoped to.

revision.title: Revision
revision.description: Version token, including the configuration hash.

recompute_started.title: Recompute Started
recompute_started.description: True when saving started a recomputation.

json_schema.title: Json Schema
json_schema.description: JSON schema of 'values' with x-unit/x-step/x-group/x-rule for rendering.

ShellCounts.title: ShellCounts
ShellCounts.description: Counters in the navigation (open findings, linked signals).

entity_id.title: Entity Id
entity_id.description: Mapped HA entity; null = not mapped.

expects_regular_updates.title: Expects Regular Updates
expects_regular_updates.description: Only then can staleness be derived from the age (ADR-003).

age_s.title: Age S
age_s.description: Age of the newest value; null if none.

median_update_interval_s.title: Median Update Interval S
median_update_interval_s.description: Actual median update interval over the last 24 h.

value_map.title: Value Map
value_map.description: Brongebonden waardetabel. Voor operating_mode uitsluitend canonieke modi ch/dhw/standby/afterrun/fault_blocking/unknown; meaning legt de herkomst vast.

Signal.title: Signal
Signal.description: A signal role at a scope and its mapping to a Home Assistant entity.

value_map.title: Value Map
value_map.description: Brongebonden waardetabel. Voor operating_mode uitsluitend canonieke modi ch/dhw/standby/afterrun/fault_blocking/unknown; meaning legt de herkomst vast.

SpecStatus.title: SpecStatus
SpecStatus.description: Explicit status of an installation specification (FR-03): never NULL-means-unknown.

Specification.title: Specification
Specification.description: A boiler/installation specification; unknown stays explicitly unknown (FR-03).

stub_data.title: Stub Data
stub_data.description: True when serving example data (header pill).

source_text.title: Source Text
source_text.description: Data source in the header, e.g. 'CAN-bus via HA'.

TimeRange.title: TimeRange
TimeRange.description: Half-open time range ``[start, end)``; ``end`` is ``null`` while still running.

TodaySummary.title: TodaySummary
TodaySummary.description: Caption of the mini timeline ('Vandaag 06:00-12:00 · 24 cycli · 14 kort …').

TriState.title: TriState
TriState.description: Boolean fact that can also be explicitly unknown (e.g. heat demand after a stop).

Zone.title: Zone
Zone.description: A stable, circuit-scoped heating zone in the installation profile.

cycle_starts.title: Cycle Starts
cycle_starts.description: Cycle starts included in this bin; usable to open matching timeline evidence.

few_active_zones.title: Few Active Zones
few_active_zones.description: True only when a user-configured threshold exists and this count is at or below it.

signals.title: Signals
signals.description: Mapped zone signal references and user-provided meaning, kept per role.

coverage_pct.title: Coverage Pct
coverage_pct.description: Share of eligible complete CH cycle starts with known states for all configured zones.
